children: may retrace toward 4,441 ringgit per metric ton, which is close to the bottom of the wave d.
A five-wave cycle from 4,091 ringgit may have completed, after the contract failed to break a resistance at 4,561 ringgit, the 61.8% retracement of the downtrend from 4,852 ringgit to 4,091 ringgit.
The resistance is strengthened by a similar one of 4,564 ringgit, the 161.8% projection level of an uptrend from 4,236 ringgit.
A break above 4,540 ringgit may lead to a gain into the 4,564 to 4,614 ringgit range. On the daily chart, a long-shadowed spinning top formed around a resistance at 4,572 ringgit.
The pattern looks bearish, as the bounce may end around the  channel line, which establishes resistance around 4,572 ringgit as well.
